headlines.title: 深房协：7月新建商品住宅成交同比涨超三成
headlines.summary: 深圳市房地产中介协会（简称“深房协”）发布2026年7月深圳楼市小结，据深圳市房地产信息平台数据，2026年7月全市新建商品房共计成交4502套，环比下跌35.2%，同比上涨19.3%；其中住宅成交3529套，环比下跌6.8%，同比上涨32.5%。7月新建商品房环比回落，属于正常季节性波动；住宅环比仅小幅下降，但同比实现超三成增长，表明在核心区限购优化等利好政策推动下，新房市场的真实购买力依然充沛。（人民财讯）

headlines.title_en: Shenzhen Real Estate Association: New home sales in July up over 30% year-on-year
headlines.summary_en: The Shenzhen Real Estate Intermediary Association (Shenfang Association) released a summary of Shenzhen's property market for July 2026. According to data from the Shenzhen Real Estate Information Platform, new commercial housing sales in the city totaled 4,502 units in July 2026, down 35.2% month-on-month but up 19.3% year-on-year; residential sales reached 3,529 units, down 6.8% month-on-month but up 32.5% year-on-year. The month-on-month decline in new commercial housing in July reflects normal seasonal fluctuations; residential sales fell only slightly month-on-month but grew over 30% year-on-year, indicating that real purchasing power in the new home market remains ample, supported by favorable policies such as optimized purchase restrictions in core areas. (People's Financial News)

headlines.title: 国家统计局：1-7月规模以上高技术制造业利润同比增长50.1%
headlines.summary: 1—7月份，制造业向产业链、价值链中高端转型持续推进，规模以上高技术制造业利润同比增长50.1%，拉动全部规模以上工业企业利润增长9.6个百分点。从行业看，电子及通信设备制造领域中，光纤制造、光缆制造、通信系统设备制造行业利润分别增长468.4%、62.6%、55.0%；医疗仪器设备及仪器仪表制造领域中，导航、测绘、气象及海洋专用仪器制造行业利润增长157.8%，口腔科用设备及器具制造行业利润增长74.5%。

headlines.title_en: National Bureau of Statistics: Industrial profits of high-tech manufacturing above designated size up 50.1% year-on-year in Jan-Jul
headlines.summary_en: From January to July, the manufacturing sector continued to advance toward the mid-to-high end of the industrial chain and value chain. Profits of large-scale high-tech manufacturing enterprises grew 50.1% year-on-year, contributing 9.6 percentage points to the profit growth of all large-scale industrial enterprises. By industry, within the electronics and communication equipment manufacturing sector, profits in optical fiber manufacturing, optical cable manufacturing, and communication system equipment manufacturing grew 468.4%, 62.6%, and 55.0%, respectively; within the medical instrument and equipment manufacturing sector, profits in navigation, surveying, meteorological, and marine special instrument manufacturing grew 157.8%, and dental equipment and appliance manufacturing grew 74.5%.

Small and medium-sized enterprises can apply for the Bank of Korea's special loan program. The USD/KRW exchange rate market has stabilized somewhat, but the USD/KRW level remains elevated. headlines.title: 韩国央行：预计通胀率将在相当长一段时间内持续高于目标水平
headlines.summary: 韩国央行：预计通胀率将在相当长一段时间内持续高于目标水平。 未来通胀走向面临较高不确定性，主要与油价、汇率、内需复苏节奏以及工资上涨扩散程度相关。 将继续实施能将CPI通胀率稳定在目标水平的货币政策。 在出口和投资保持高增长的推动下，预计国内经济将继续维持强劲增长。 消费复苏步伐将逐渐加快。 将评估通胀、国内经济以及金融稳定状况。 需要密切关注居民债务增长情况。 芯片领域的扩张程度、中东局势发展以及贸易环境的变化仍存在不确定性。

headlines.title_en: Bank of Korea: Inflation expected to remain above target for a considerable period
headlines.summary_en: Bank of Korea: Inflation is expected to remain above the target level for a considerable period. The future path of inflation faces high uncertainty, mainly related to oil prices, exchange rates, the pace of domestic demand recovery, and the spread of wage increases. Will continue to implement monetary policy that stabilizes CPI inflation at the target level. The domestic economy is expected to continue strong growth, driven by high growth in exports and investment. The pace of consumption recovery will gradually accelerate. Will assess inflation, domestic economic conditions, and financial stability. Household debt growth needs close monitoring. Uncertainty remains regarding the scale of expansion in the chip sector, developments in the Middle East, and changes in the trade environment.

headlines.title_en: Regulators hold private equity compliance and policy interpretation training session in Shanghai
headlines.summary_en: On August 27, the Shanghai Securities Regulatory Bureau, the Asset Management Association of China, and other relevant departments held the 2026 Private Fund Compliance and Policy Interpretation Training Session (Shanghai venue) in Shanghai. It is understood that the training covered interpretations of the Implementation Plan for Comprehensive Rectification of Illegal Cross-Border Securities, Futures and Fund Operations, the Guiding Opinions of the General Office of the State Council on Strengthening Regulation, Preventing Risks, and Promoting High-Quality Development of Private Investment Funds, an analysis of violations and compliance requirements in the Shanghai jurisdiction, common issues found in self-regulatory inspections and warning reminders, and key points of securities and futures arbitration rulings with case analysis of private funds. (China Securities Journal Bull Market)

headlines.title: 金融监管总局对西藏灾情启动保险业二级救灾应急响应
headlines.summary: 记者8月27日从国家金融监督管理总局获悉，根据西藏吉隆县泥石流灾情进展和保险业应对灾害事故处置工作机制，金融监管总局启动保险业二级救灾应急响应，同时指导银行业做好相关金融保障服务工作。8月26日10时30分许，因尼泊尔一侧发生泥石流灾害，造成西藏日喀则市吉隆县吉隆口岸重大人员伤亡、失联。灾害发生后，金融监管总局迅速指导银行业保险业和属地金融监管局全力做好灾害应急处置和保险理赔服务等工作。根据金融监管总局工作部署，西藏金融监管局派出工作组赴灾害现场，有关保险机构立即启动应急预案，开展承保情况摸排，配合地方党委政府和有关部门做好灾害应对处置有关工作。（新华社

headlines.title_en: National Financial Regulatory Administration initiates level-two emergency response for insurance industry following Tibet disaster
headlines.summary_en: A reporter learned on August 27 from the National Financial Regulatory Administration (NFRA) that, based on the progress of the mudslide disaster in Gyirong County, Tibet, and the insurance industry's disaster response and handling mechanism, the NFRA activated a Level II disaster emergency response for the insurance industry, while guiding the banking sector to provide relevant financial support services. At approximately 10:30 a.m. on August 26, a mudslide on the Nepalese side caused heavy casualties and missing persons at the Gyirong Port in Gyirong County, Shigatse, Tibet. After the disaster, the NFRA promptly guided the banking and insurance industries and local financial regulatory bureaus to fully carry out disaster emergency response and insurance claims services. In accordance with the NFRA's deployment, the Tibet Financial Regulatory Bureau dispatched a working group to the disaster site, and relevant insurance institutions immediately activated emergency response plans, conducting underwriting investigations and coordinating with local party committees, governments, and relevant departments on disaster response efforts. (Xinhua)

headlines.title: 天风证券：以De-Risking路径锁定创新药高成长机会
headlines.summary: 天风证券研报称，2025年起中国创新药BD出海进入快速增长期，2026年上半年出海交易总金额同比增长34.5%，全球占比已超30%；同时海外新药投融资持续回暖，全球GLP-1、小核酸、ADC等新分子药物处于研发与商业化黄金期带动CDMO需求。创新药行业经历2025年系统性的资产价值重估之后，市场对确定性的需求显著提升，锚定低风险、高景气方向成为当前投资的核心命题。当前创新药投资逻辑是以De-Risking路径锁定创新药高成长机会。随着创新药产业链景气度提升，建议关注大单品放量及相应机会。

headlines.title_en: Tianfeng Securities: Locking in high-growth opportunities in innovative drugs via De-Risking strategy
headlines.summary_en: Tianfeng Securities research report stated that since 2025, China's innovative drug BD out-licensing has entered a rapid growth phase, with total outbound deal value in the first half of 2026 up 34.5% year-on-year, accounting for over 30% of the global share; meanwhile, overseas financing for new drugs has continued to recover, with global GLP-1, oligonucleotide, ADC, and other new molecular drugs in a golden period of R&D and commercialization, driving CDMO demand. After the systematic asset value reassessment of the innovative drug industry in 2025, market demand for certainty has risen significantly, and anchoring low-risk, high-prosperity directions has become the core investment theme. The current investment logic for innovative drugs is to lock in high-growth opportunities through a De-Risking path. As the prosperity of the innovative drug industry chain improves, attention is recommended on blockbuster product ramp-ups and related opportunities.

headlines.title: 百度新增香港为主要上市地，将于9月1日完成双重主要上市
headlines.summary: 百度在港交所公告，本公司自愿将其于香港联交所的第二上市地位转换为主要上市，并将于2026年9月1日生效。本公司将自生效日期起于香港联交所及纳斯达克双重主要上市。股份标记“S”将于主要转换后自2026年9月1日起自其在香港联交所的港元及人民币柜台的股份简称中删除。据百度官方新闻，此次转换不涉及公司发行新股或进行任何融资活动。

headlines.title_en: Baidu adds Hong Kong as primary listing venue, to complete dual primary listing on Sept 1
headlines.summary_en: Baidu announced on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange that it will voluntarily convert its secondary listing on the HKEX to a primary listing, effective September 1, 2026. From the effective date, the company will be dual-primary listed on the HKEX and Nasdaq. The 'S' marker will be removed from the stock short names on both the HKD and RMB counters on the HKEX starting September 1, 2026, following the conversion. According to Baidu's official news, this conversion does not involve issuing new shares or any fundraising activities.

headlines.title: 中国即将发行或正在发行的国债和政策性金融债
headlines.summary: 韩国央行：预计通胀率将在相当长一段时间内持续高于目标水平。 未来通胀走向面临较高不确定性，主要与油价、汇率、内需复苏节奏以及工资上涨扩散程度相关。 将继续实施能将CPI通胀率稳定在目标水平的货币政策。 在出口和投资保持高增长的推动下，预计国内经济将继续维持强劲增长。 消费复苏步伐将逐渐加快。 将评估通胀、国内经济以及金融稳定状况。 需要密切关注居民债务增长情况。 芯片领域的扩张程度、中东局势发展以及贸易环境的变化仍存在不确定性。
